text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 22 cm, and it holds roughly 3 strips of dark, well-cooked bacon.

Each strip is about 18-20 cm long when stretched out. Cooked bacon runs about 8-10 g per strip, and thick-cut strips can reach 12 g. These look thick and crispy, so I'll use about 10 g each.

3 strips × 10 g ≈ 30 g.

Cooked bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g, so 30 g comes to roughly 160 kcal.

{"kcal": 160, "mass_g": 30}
